### Key Risks

- **Extreme drowsiness and dizziness:** Their sedative effects amplify each other, increasing the chance of falls, accidents, and trouble waking up.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHEIkXXl9v8qryT2vIejLZdtCWu-sqIOtjTMsvjmrYk2nl2HmaUs3ushzLKuBRd7xB50ZygqPNUMkdx1t-JGkyShAa7RiN9KLSVXzlpw9R5-EVbk7MSgtzv83mlC_ljHFwlkM2Ds_5Y5BB-fwV6)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdwHEIkXXBNXWbJ9JIo0FOz9nf8goZn_9q8d5tJj_foCZbTEqqasZsIpHITKklVpBXL0ZhN6Yb8RRXr01xqBswg6h6Byf1zgH-Yp2bFfcRYq4P__tnEPEbdojoPnFUfN1P_K7fU7xYS26qDoj5_t-BPph-zElVsbT)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjwEBxCJF1_df1mnevxZkwbzApUYuQ_5k7OrVrKB4SL9N_F_1mAaSDg_0owmiWboNuEhQ2lHDpgyEsYGGvK6un70yhtPjIzFGORwdZUugvRYFnKqxujNi0vJR0cS5KVPrNdklWhuLpEaIJdiRTAlhAFXw38pNYVxl1UTabhklomsdq_0Fv0Am0XpsoEzoSxHdzg)
- **Impaired driving and coordination:** Reaction time, judgment, and motor skills drop sharply—even if you feel alert.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXbfTF9rnlP4fLLMPlO7nBFiPjvqdROai8k8kQpg_l6s3JNWz2QIF-kYdnF2UbZUNsCtNUkBtvQDx3NPiOv_8EzdyfUtEjOAPWcYVX3HSEE4Os5M8aBqF_kDe8tJ3LYQeA3ASkpFVrKQ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdwHEIkXXBNXWbJ9JIo0FOz9nf8goZn_9q8d5tJj_foCZbTEqqasZsIpHITKklVpBXL0ZhN6Yb8RRXr01xqBswg6h6Byf1zgH-Yp2bFfcRYq4P__tnEPEbdojoPnFUfN1P_K7fU7xYS26qDoj5_t-BPph-zElVsbT)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeQHEIkXX9_8j4AiJjZtNrI1KUQkGK76kKDNnCwRFMGohHwq0gSytGFI3tcRK4Tt4DMs8ipdGlzYKY67esuLkFQgwpY6_R6U2Gj3Eu1L_Bw-xPJSNloHRzeDBUfh3nSk2LXK8xO-XHSu1-pNJ47m3R4x-2BZOJfD40i4)
- **Severe breathing and overdose risks:** Heavy combining can cause dangerously slow breathing, confusion, hallucinations, or loss of consciousness, especially in older adults or when mixed with other sedatives.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXXe1BAkRoO-4vzIE4_5RGKtstE9MmbqXGcjP-532Pf66EvPD3JTnJCxf6lu5y63mOGT7RYwbMH9ovth-j_6q095u44lVT0C7daDAI2pZIPal0Q4mVL3zwi9l2dEcQ9ZvzGTmwzVISa)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHEIkXXl9v8qryT2vIejLZdtCWu-sqIOtjTMsvjmrYk2nl2HmaUs3ushzLKuBRd7xB50ZygqPNUMkdx1t-JGkyShAa7RiN9KLSVXzlpw9R5-EVbk7MSgtzv83mlC_ljHFwlkM2Ds_5Y5BB-fwV6)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXbfTF9rnlP4fLLMPlO7nBFiPjvqdROai8k8kQpg_l6s3JNWz2QIF-kYdnF2UbZUNsCtNUkBtvQDx3NPiOv_8EzdyfUtEjOAPWcYVX3HSEE4Os5M8aBqF_kDe8tJ3LYQeA3ASkpFVrKQ)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeQHEIkXX9_8j4AiJjZtNrI1KUQkGK76kKDNnCwRFMGohHwq0gSytGFI3tcRK4Tt4DMs8ipdGlzYKY67esuLkFQgwpY6_R6U2Gj3Eu1L_Bw-xPJSNloHRzeDBUfh3nSk2LXK8xO-XHSu1-pNJ47m3R4x-2BZOJfD40i4)

### Practical Precautions

- **Avoid mixing them:** Skip alcohol while taking Benadryl, and do not take Benadryl to sleep after drinking.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeQHEIkXX9_8j4AiJjZtNrI1KUQkGK76kKDNnCwRFMGohHwq0gSytGFI3tcRK4Tt4DMs8ipdGlzYKY67esuLkFQgwpY6_R6U2Gj3Eu1L_Bw-xPJSNloHRzeDBUfh3nSk2LXK8xO-XHSu1-pNJ47m3R4x-2BZOJfD40i4)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdwHEIkXXBNXWbJ9JIo0FOz9nf8goZn_9q8d5tJj_foCZbTEqqasZsIpHITKklVpBXL0ZhN6Yb8RRXr01xqBswg6h6Byf1zgH-Yp2bFfcRYq4P__tnEPEbdojoPnFUfN1P_K7fU7xYS26qDoj5_t-BPph-zElVsbT)
- **Allow time to clear:** Diphenhydramine typically takes around 24 hours for most adults to clear (and up to 36 hours for older adults), depending on dose and individual metabolism.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXXe1BAkRoO-4vzIE4_5RGKtstE9MmbqXGcjP-532Pf66EvPD3JTnJCxf6lu5y63mOGT7RYwbMH9ovth-j_6q095u44lVT0C7daDAI2pZIPal0Q4mVL3zwi9l2dEcQ9ZvzGTmwzVISa)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeQHEIkXX9_8j4AiJjZtNrI1KUQkGK76kKDNnCwRFMGohHwq0gSytGFI3tcRK4Tt4DMs8ipdGlzYKY67esuLkFQgwpY6_R6U2Gj3Eu1L_Bw-xPJSNloHRzeDBUfh3nSk2LXK8xO-XHSu1-pNJ47m3R4x-2BZOJfD40i4)
- **Watch for hidden ingredients:** Check labels on "PM" products, cold/flu syrups, and laxatives, as they may contain diphenhydramine or hidden alcohol.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdwHEIkXXBNXWbJ9JIo0FOz9nf8goZn_9q8d5tJj_foCZbTEqqasZsIpHITKklVpBXL0ZhN6Yb8RRXr01xqBswg6h6Byf1zgH-Yp2bFfcRYq4P__tnEPEbdojoPnFUfN1P_K7fU7xYS26qDoj5_t-BPph-zElVsbT)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeQHEIkXX9_8j4AiJjZtNrI1KUQkGK76kKDNnCwRFMGohHwq0gSytGFI3tcRK4Tt4DMs8ipdGlzYKY67esuLkFQgwpY6_R6U2Gj3Eu1L_Bw-xPJSNloHRzeDBUfh3nSk2LXK8xO-XHSu1-pNJ47m3R4x-2BZOJfD40i4)
